summary: Customer reports unauthorized withdrawal; agent freezes account and investigates.

intents.keywords: I am worried my savings account shows of withdrawal...someone stealing my money

issues.reason(s): Customer did not authorize the transaction.

intents.actions of agent: Confirmed transaction details, froze the account, and filed a fraud report.
intents.Process Request: Reverse the fraudulent transaction and keep the customer updated.
intents.resolution: The agent will reverse the transaction within 5 to 7 days.
